sites.name: Lumbini, birthplace of the Buddha (Maya Devi Temple)
sites.what: Sacred garden and archaeological remains at the Buddha's birthplace (UNESCO World Heritage).

access.tickets: Conservation fee NPR 1,000 a person a day for foreigners (no RBA rate for the Nepali rupee); SAARC and Myanmar visitors NPR 700, Indians NPR 80. Pay by cash, QR code or online.
